name: agent-link
description: Deprecated Agent Link compatibility helper; superseded as a product by Threadspace/Rooms. Existing SSH/OpenClaw workflows only.

interface.shortDescription: Deprecated; retained for existing SSH/OpenClaw workflows.
interface.longDescription: Agent Link is deprecated as a separate product. Threadspace owns clients and agent connectors; Rooms owns shared authorization and durable history. Existing helper commands and profiles remain compatible while consumers verify migration. No automatic migration or drop-in replacement is provided. See the repository retirement guide.
defaultPrompt: Explain Agent Link deprecation and the migration guide before using an existing approved legacy profile.
